description: This file contains unit tests for the in-memory grain storage provider in an Orleans-based application. It includes test class definitions, fixture setup for configuring a test cluster with multiple memory storage providers, and test categories. The tests verify that the in-memory storage provider correctly implements persistence interfaces and handles operations in a non-durable, in-memory context.
